metadata.description: Bussin skills for shipping features with Claude Code

plugins.name: bussin
plugins.description: Ten bussin- skills: an autonomous build loop, a feature build workflow, portable TypeScript feature architecture, Drizzle data access, React and Next.js rules, the house UI system, accessibility, SEO with JSON-LD, honest feedback and human-sounding writing, plus short aliases such as /autoloop.

plugins.name: bussin-loop-status
plugins.description: Live status of a bussin-autoloop run in the status line and a pane: progress, running items, elapsed time, ETA, input and output tokens, cost and models, and a Stop button that lets running items finish.
